description_en: Invokes UnassociateVpcCidrBlock to delete a secondary CIDR block from a VPC
kebab_example: aliyun vpc unassociate-vpc-cidr-block --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-o6wrloqsdqc9io3mg0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnassociateVpcCidrBlock

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC from which you want to delete a secondary CIDR block. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要删除附加网段的VPC所在地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC from which you want to delete a secondary CIDR block
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The secondary IPv4 CIDR block to delete.

You must specify one of the SecondaryCidrBlock parameter and the Ipv6CidrBlock parameter, but you cannot specify both
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的附加IPv4网段。

参数SecondaryCidrBlock和参数Ipv6CidrBlock必须输入一个且不能都输入
parameters.name: secondary_cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
The secondary IPv6 CIDR block to delete.

You must specify one of the Ipv6CidrBlock parameter and the SecondaryCidrBlock parameter, but you cannot specify both
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的附加IPv6网段。

参数Ipv6CidrBlock和参数SecondaryCidrBlock必须输入一个且不能都输入
parameters.name: ipv6_cidr_block
